mapper.insert: insert into personal_info (id, nickname, tag, description, avatar, website, email, github, location, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{nickname}, #{tag}, #{description}, #{avatar}, #{website}, #{email}, #{github}, #{location}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) on duplicate key update nickname = values(nickname), tag = values(tag), description = values(description), avatar = values(avatar), website = values(website), email = values(email), github = values(github), location = values(location), update_time = values(update_time)
